vectorization.method: pixel-edge boundary tracing with collinear-point merging
vectorization.mask: alpha > 127 when the tile has transparency, otherwise luminance > 64
vectorization.output: one SVG per accepted tile beside its PNG: a single fill-rule="evenodd" path, viewBox 0 0 128 128
vectorization.validation: re-read the SVG, rasterize its outlines at pixel centers with even-odd parity, and compare with the source mask
